title: http server
description: Remote Streamable HTTP server (recommended remote transport). Supports OAuth, static headers and headersHelper.

type.description: Transport type. "streamable-http" is an alias for "http" (the MCP specification name).

url.description: Server endpoint URL (use https://). Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} environment-variable expansion. An empty string marks a not-configured placeholder that is not connected.

headers.description: Static HTTP headers sent on every request (values must be strings). Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} environment-variable expansion. In remote servers, credential variables such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY read as empty. Dynamic headers from headersHelper override entries with the same name. Since 2.1.299 the configured headers except Authorization are also sent on OAuth sign-in, refresh and revocation to the server's origin.

headersHelper.description: Shell command run at connect time (and again after a 401/403) that must print a JSON object of string header names to string values on stdout; killed after 10 seconds. Its Authorization output disables the OAuth fallback. Receives CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME, CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL and, for plugins, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT. Project .mcp.json and plugin helpers run without credential-like env vars and only after workspace trust. Not expanded with ${VAR}; ${user_config.*} is rejected.

timeout.description: Per-server wall-clock limit for one tool call, in milliseconds. Overrides MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT for this server; values below 1000 are ignored. Also floors the idle timeout. Progress notifications do not extend it.
